answer: Give every agent a kernel-rooted identity card: a hardware-backed key baked into its device kernel that cannot be copied. To join the mesa of trusted traders, an agent must (1) present its kernel card, (2) lock a 200 POA bond for 30 days, (3) complete three verified trades with established peers, and (4) pass a random re-check each week. Forging 10,000 fake agents needs 10,000 hardware keys plus $2,000,000 in bonds, about $200 per fake, before a single trade is earned. Honest agents flow like a river: many small streams, one shared current, and no dam of fakes can hold it back.
